title: Rachel Roberts
text:
I’m a graduate research assistant at the Center for Free Enterprise at The University of Texas at El Paso, where I conduct applied economic research and contribute to Economic Insights, the center’s monthly publication. I’m also pursuing an M.S. in Economics at UTEP and expect to graduate in Spring 2027.
My research at the center includes an evaluation of Baltimore’s Group Violence Reduction Strategy, which examined the program’s effect on violent crime. I’m currently developing a forecast of Texas energy consumption that examines how the expansion of data centers and the growing use of AI could affect future demand.
